_materials: crafting materials, from common to very rare. Salvage gives the first three; all four also drop directly (currencyDrops). Support gems are never salvaged.

dust.name: Grave Dust
dust.text: Ground from Normal and Magic items. Drops now and then.

essence.name: Ember Essence
essence.text: Drawn from Rare items. Elites and bosses drop it.

shard.name: Relic Shard
shard.text: Broken from Unique items. Rare drop from elites, bosses, tyrants and rift guardians.

pearl.name: Gloam Pearl
pearl.text: Never salvaged. A very rare drop from bosses, tyrants, rift guardians and the pinnacle. Raises affixes to T1 and ascends uniques.

_salvage: per rarity (Normal, Magic, Rare, Unique): material -> [base, per item level]; amount = floor(base + perLevel * itemLevel)
_currencyDrops: materials that drop on the ground by themselves. Per source: material -> [chance, min, max]. Amount = int(min..max) x (1 + scale[material] x level), rounded. Rolled once per kill or opening.
_embers: forged from materials at the moment of use. cost per material is scaled by craftScale. unique: also works on Unique items (cost x craftScale.uniqueMult); uniqueOnly: only on uniques

change.name: Ember of Change
change.text: Rerolls one random affix into a new one of the same kind (prefix or suffix).

choice.name: Ember of Choice
choice.text: Rerolls the affix you chose into a new one of the same kind.

whet.name: Whetstone
whet.text: Rolls the value of the chosen affix again, inside its tier. Works on uniques too, at a higher price.

rise.name: Rising Ember
rise.text: Raises the chosen affix by one tier (T3 becomes T2). The item level limits the best tier. Rising to T2 also takes a Relic Shard, to T1 a Gloam Pearl.

bind.name: Binding Ember
bind.text: Turns a Magic item into a Rare one. Its affixes stay, one or two new ones join them.

crown.name: Crowning Ember
crown.text: Adds one new random affix to a Rare item that has a free prefix or suffix.

wax.name: Sealing Wax
wax.text: Seals the chosen affix: the next Ember of Change or Choice leaves it alone.

ascend.name: Ember of Ascension
ascend.text: Re-forges a Unique at the level of your deepest area: new item level, all values rolled again.

_craftScale: cost multiplier for dust and essence = (1 + perLevel * itemLevel) * (1 + perCraft * timesCrafted), x uniqueMult on uniques; shards and pearls never scale. riseTo = extra cost of a Rising Ember by the tier it lifts the affix to (not scaled).
_corruption: once per item. outcome weights; extraRoll multiplies the best tier's value of the extra affix
_gamble: price = (base + perLevel*L + perLevelSq*L*L) * slotMult[slot], L = level of the current area. Rarity from items.json dropTables.gamble; uniques of the hero's class and that slot only.
_lootDefaults: loot rules of a new hero: minRarity 1 = normal items are salvaged on the spot (not shown on the ground)
